run_compute_blaser2: run the CLI to compute BLASER-2.0 scores on source and target speech or text data
run_apply_supervised_blaser2: run the supervised BLASER-2 model to score source and target embeddings with optional reference
run_apply_unsupervised_blaser: run the unsupervised BLASER scorer using rowwise cosine similarity on source and target embeddings
run_apply_encoder: run a SONAR encoder to convert speech audio paths or text sentences into embedding vectors
review_compute_blaser2: review the compute_blaser2 function that encodes inputs and computes both supervised and unsupervised BLASER scores
